description: This is a Java source file defining the ModelParam class, which represents a parameter in a service model within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes properties for parameter metadata, validation, and WSDL integration.

classes.name: ModelParam
classes.description: Represents a parameter used in service models, including validation, default values, and WSDL compatibility.

classes.name: ModelParam.ModelParamValidator
classes.description: Inner class used for validation logic on ModelParam instances, supporting dynamic validator methods and error messaging.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the parameter using class name, method, and failure message or resource details.

methods.name: getPrimaryFailMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the primary failure message for validators, localized.

methods.name: getFailMessage
methods.description: Returns the failure message, defaulting to a generic message if none are set.

methods.name: getShortDisplayDescription
methods.description: Provides a brief description suitable for display, indicating parameter name, type, and mode.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the parameter's default value, expanded and converted to the appropriate type.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the parameter, wrapping it with a flexible string expander.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves child parameters, initializing the list if not already present.

methods.name: copyDefaultValue
methods.description: Copies the default value from another ModelParam object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the parameter's name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the parameter's properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the parameter.

methods.name: getWSDLPart
methods.description: Creates and returns a WSDL Part object based on this parameter for WSDL definitions.

methods.name: java2wsdlType
methods.description: Maps Java types to corresponding WSDL type strings.
